 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:50750

 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal

On The 8 th Of October, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 41117 of 2025
 Aman Khare
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Baboo Ji Chourasia - Advocate for the applicant.
 Ms. Priyanka Mishra - Government Advocate for the res
 Order

This is first application under Section 483 of BNSS filed for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.430/2024 registered at Police Station Civil Lines, District Chhatarpur (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, 471, 201, 34 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Civil Lines, District Chhatarpur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 28.06.2025.
2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the present applicant is that he committed fraud with the complainant by selling shop.
Therefore, case was registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He is in custody since 28.06.2025.
Charge sheet has been filed.
The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:50750 2 MCRC-41117-2025 released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently,
application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of B.N.S.S.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
